text:
deploy-bot: Release deploy-2026.03.12 -> prod blocked by env-parity check: secret key encoding mismatch for service inference-gateway. check /ops/deploybot/logs/1768001111.

maria: got it — thanks for the alert. who can confirm staging vs prod keystore aliases?

raj: looking now. staging keystore alias = "staging-infer-kms"; prod keystore alias = "infer-kms-legacy". looks like a rename happened in the values used by the chart.

elaine: oof, so the image we bumped expects the new alias but prod still has legacy config. how did that get past preflight?

sam: quick summary: release notes reference imageTag=1.4.2 which uses new KMS path. our staging helm override file included the new alias, but the prod helm values were not updated (ops PR staged but not applied).

maria: TL;DR: staging secret path != prod secret path -> runtime will fail decrypting model keys in prod. Recommendation? rollback or patch?

raj: patching prod values will take a maintenance window because the ops cluster has a rotation in ~2h. fastest is to rollback the image pin in the release to 1.4.1 which is compatible.

elaine: what's the risk if we force-promote without patch? high chance of 500s for inference requests until keys readable. not acceptable during the midday change window.

sam: +1 rollback. Also propose adding an automated keystore-alias parity check to the release gate: compare keystore aliases and KMS ARNs between staging and prod before deploybot allows promotion.

maria: creating an incident/ticket for rollout hold and rollback action now. tagging @infra @release-owner. Also adding a short hotfix checklist for ops to avoid reintroducing this.

sam: snippet of the offending helm override that caused drift:
```
# staging values override (applied)
keystore:
  alias: staging-infer-kms
  kms_arn: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:12345:key/abcd

# prod values (still legacy)
keystore:
  alias: infer-kms-legacy
  kms_arn: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:12345:key/efgh
```

maria: @deploy-bot please mark release as HELD and notify product + oncall. add label: env-parity-failure. :warning:

deploy-bot: Release deploy-2026.03.12 marked HELD by @maria. Notifying: #product, #oncall, ops-infra. Reason: env parity: keystore alias mismatch.

raj: I'll coordinate rollback to image 1.4.1 and confirm smoke tests. will post ETA in 15m.

elaine: thanks team — after rollback, let's add the keystore parity gate to the release checklist and a quick postmortem note in the release issue.
